focus_areas: Grounding and physical plausibility of the spare magazine and bullet (melting/floating check).
Mechanical connectivity between stock, receiver, and grip.
Physical plausibility of the optic mounting system.
Texture consistency between metal receiver and polymer furniture.
Geometric straightness of the barrel and rail.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interface between the optical sight and the Picatinny rail; AI often fails to render the mounting clamps correctly. Crucially, verify the physical grounding of the spare magazine and bullet in the foreground—ensure they have distinct bottom edges and cast appropriate contact shadows on the white surface, as they appear potentially melted or floating in the initial inspection.
image_description: A close-up, high-resolution image of a black compact submachine gun (resembling an MP5K) against a white background. The weapon features a Picatinny rail with an optical sight, a pistol grip integrated into the stock, and a short barrel. A detachable box magazine is inserted into the mag well. In the foreground, a spare magazine and a single bullet cartridge are visible on the surface.
